lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，穿过整片深水。
lines.en: I sweep my tail slowly through the deep.
I glide under the surface.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾鳍，身体往上升。
lines.en: One beat of my fluke lifts me.

lines.zh: 我沿着洋流游，很少改方向。
lines.en: I follow the current and rarely turn.

lines.zh: 我的长鳍在水里划开一道线。
lines.en: My long fin draws a line in the water.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，像在赶很远的路。
lines.en: I swim slowly, as if on a long journey.
I rise and my back breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口气，水雾散开。
lines.en: I blow out; mist scatters.

lines.zh: 我又沉下去，继续往前走。
lines.en: I sink back and continue.

lines.zh: 我绕过一座海底的岩丘。
lines.en: I round a submerged hill.
I head for warmer water.

lines.zh: 我一路唱着，声音传得很远。
lines.en: I sing along the way; the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，露出白腹。
lines.en: I roll and show my pale belly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉到更深的地方。
lines.en: I sink slowly deeper.

lines.zh: 我从一群鱼上方缓缓经过。
lines.en: I pass slowly over a school of fish.
I rise again to breathe.
I swim toward the northern water.
I have swum all day without stopping.
I float at the surface, breathing slowly.
I hang deep and motionless.

lines.zh: 我发出一串低长的声音。
lines.en: I let out a long, low sound.
I lift a fin and let it fall.
I am listening to an echo far off.
A few old scars line my hide.

lines.zh: 我停在一片安静的水里。
lines.en: I rest in a patch of quiet water.
I let my fluke sink slowly.
I wait for the surface to settle.
I sing one more phrase.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在水里慢慢扇动。
lines.en: My fin fans slowly in the water.

lines.zh: 我抬头，光从上面洒下来。
lines.en: I look up; light falls from above.
I hold at the same depth.
I look up from below and see you.
You are beside me. So small.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过去，让你看清我。
lines.en: I turn slowly so you can see me.

lines.zh: 我喷了一口气，水雾落在你身上。
lines.en: I blow once; mist settles on you.
I roll and extend my fin toward you.
I sing once, very low.

lines.zh: 我记住你在水里的位置。
lines.en: I have your position in the water.
I sink another stretch.
I drift off and return.
I list slightly and swim on.

lines.zh: 我发出一声闷长的低鸣。
lines.en: A long, muffled note comes from me.
I rise and take a breath.

lines.zh: 深海里，我的歌声传得很远。
lines.en: In the deep, my song carries far.
My fin droops.
I pause half a beat before going on.
I turn and look.

lines.zh: 水从我身上的伤口流过。
lines.en: Water flows over the wound.
I retreat toward the deep.
My song breaks off.
I never eat things like this.
My mouth opens, then slowly closes.

lines.zh: 那点小鱼，我张嘴就漏掉。
lines.en: That little fish slips through my open mouth.
Too small. I can hardly see it.
I nudge it up and let it sink.
I move toward your hand.
I drift away again.
I leave it where it lies.
You touch me; I barely shift.
My fin brushes you, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我像一堵会动的墙。
lines.en: We collide. I am a moving wall.
I turn my bulk away.
The water churns around us.
I draw back a distance.
I am not at all offended.
I return to my original course.
I rise for a breath.
Another sings not far off.
I answer with a long phrase.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳍几乎相触。
lines.en: We swim abreast, fins almost touching.

lines.zh: 它的歌和我的调子不一样。
lines.en: Its song is in a different key from mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起跃出水面，又落下。
lines.en: We breach together, then fall back.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此游了一圈。
lines.en: We circle each other once.
We sink into the deep together.
Its body is shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们唱歌的时候，声音叠在一起。
lines.en: When we sing, our voices overlap.

lines.zh: 我们沿着同一条洋流走。
lines.en: We follow the same current.
I take it in my mouth.
I nudge it.

lines.zh: 它太小，我几乎感觉不到。
lines.en: It is so small I barely feel it.
Pushing it to you. Don't drop it.
It slides down from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了一下就放开。
lines.en: I touch it with my mouth and let go.
I leave it in the water.
I have not taken it with me.
I sink down once more.
I have seen you in the water.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍一摆，船身晃了。
lines.en: One sweep of my fluke rocks the boat.
I make a long sound.
I am not fast, but I am large.
I roll, my fin forward.
My great mouth has opened.
You will not swim far.
I am right below you.
I follow, always beneath.
You swim up; I rise too.
My long fins hang and drift with the water.
You turn; I follow half a beat late.
I push the water toward you.
You cut me; only a mark.
You can hear my song.
My song stops; the water pressure grows.

lines.zh: 我用身体撞你，水都压过来。
lines.en: I ram you; the water presses in.
My fluke sweeps and catches you.
My fin strikes you.
I rise and come down.
That one misses.

lines.zh: 我拱起背，把你顶出水面。
lines.en: I arch my back and lift you above the surface.
I push you far off.
You pull back; the water still churns.
I open my mouth; the water rushes in.

lines.zh: 巨大的尾鳍扫过，浪起来了。
lines.en: My huge fluke sweeps past and raises a wave.
I sing a phrase first.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口气，水雾很高。
lines.en: I blow; the mist rises high.

lines.zh: 迁徙的路上，我先唱一段。
lines.en: On the migration road, I sing first.
I swim slowly forward.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在光里显得很长。
lines.en: My fin looks long in the light.
I swim toward a distant sound.
I memorize this water.

lines.zh: 我浮出水面，喷出一道水柱。
lines.en: I surface and blow a tall spout.
The water heats; I sink away.

lines.zh: 我落到海面上，砸出很大的浪。
lines.en: I land on the sea and throw up a great wave.

lines.zh: 我该能在水里呼吸，可这次不行。
lines.en: I should breathe water, but not this time.

lines.zh: 爆炸在水里闷响，我晃了一下。
lines.en: The blast booms through the water; I rock.
Something lodges in my thick hide.

lines.zh: 那光透过水，刺进我的身体。
lines.en: That light pierces the water and me.

lines.zh: 我游得太久，没有力气了。
lines.en: I have swum too long and have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打在海面上，水都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea; the water lights up.
The water is gone; I fall.
